unit.title: Shapes, Patterns and Space
unit.about_unit: Explores angles, turns, right angles, acute and obtuse angles, symmetrical patterns, tessellations, and directional navigation.

facilitation_guide.headline: Embodied Geometry
facilitation_guide.text: Use the statue game and yoga postures to feel angles as amount of turning.

facilitation_guide.headline: Angle Tester
facilitation_guide.text: Construct cardboard angle testers to check right angles in the classroom environment.

chapter.title: Finding Directions
chapter.tagline: Mastering cardinal directions, the rising sun, grid navigation, and compass maps
chapter.overview: Manu stands outside at dawn facing the rising Sun to identify East, West, North, and South. With four little chicks lost on a grid farm map, students use turns, grid coordinates, and cardinal directions to navigate routes and landmarks.

sections.title: Facing the Rising Sun: Cardinal Directions
sections.subtitle: Deducing North, South, East, and West using solar orientation

storyNarrative.dialogue: When I face the morning rising Sun, I face EAST. Behind me is WEST. My left hand points NORTH, and my right hand points SOUTH!

concept.heading: The Solar Compass Rule
concept.keyRule: Facing East: Back = West, Left = North, Right = South.

sections.title: The Four Little Chicks Direction Puzzle
sections.subtitle: Solving spatial clues involving relative turns and steps

storyNarrative.dialogue: Peep! Chick 1 walked 3 steps North and turned East. Chick 2 walked 2 steps West and turned South! Where will our paths cross?

concept.heading: Coordinate Vector Steps
concept.keyRule: Displacements on a 2D plane can be mapped as orthogonal (x, y) steps along cardinal axes.
